sql: SELECT sum(t.amount) AS total_deposits FROM bank.transactions t JOIN bank.branches b ON b.branch_id = t.branch_id WHERE b.city = 'Surat' AND t.txn_type = 'deposit' AND t.txn_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND t.txn_at < date_trunc('month', now()) LIMIT 100
explanation: Deposits at the Surat branch in October 2026 totalled INR 4,82,13,907.55.
